sam_partnerships: Heads-up — Zenith wants a joint co-sell POC starting next Tue. They need our inference + their app in a peered VPC. Key asks: SAML SSO, dedicated capacity pricing (2x A100 equiv), SOC2 docs, and a canary rollout plan. Who can own the tech lead?

kai_partner-eng: I’ll own partner onboarding. Can someone draft the network/runbook for a Private deployment? Their infra team is strict about no public egress.

liam_sales-engineer: I can be Redwood tech lead. Quick Qs: expected throughput/latency targets? Model family and max seq length? That will affect kernel selection and cost.

sam_partnerships: Target is ~200 reqs/min steady, ~burst 400, and p50 <150ms for chat. Starting model is a 7B conversational variant (redwood-7b-v1-ish). Seq len ~1024.

aditi_solutions: For SAML we need the IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL) + SP metadata from us. Omar — can you take point on the security questionnaire? They sent the standard enterprise pack.

omar_security: I’ll take SOC2/infrastructure answers. KMS/HSM and network isolation Qs need infra input. If customer wants CMK (customer-managed keys) we need to confirm HSM integration in Dedicated/Private.

kai_partner-eng: They said CMK is optional for now. Biggest blocker: their security team insists on single VPC peering and no egress to public LBs. Can we propose Private (VPC) deployment with dedicated GPUs behind customer VPC peering?

liam_sales-engineer: Yes — Private + Dedicated capacity supports VPC peering. Note: Private control plane + reserved GPUs requires ~2 week lead for infra prep and ent. onboarding. For pricing: rough committed estimate below, will formalize in SOW.

sam_partnerships: Please paste the rough estimate here so I can share with partner.

liam_sales-engineer: Rough numbers (ballpark):
- Reserved 2x A100-equivalent pool: $28,000/mo committed
- Setup & network prep (one-time): $6,000
- Optional 24/7 enterprise support addon: $4,500/mo
This assumes typical infra egress/caching. Final quote after perf baseline. :thinking_face:

kai_partner-eng: That’s helpful. They want canary traffic steering and a fallback to a quantized model if latency spikes. Is that supported?

aditi_solutions: Yes — runtime supports model variants + routing policies. You can do a canary route with 10% traffic, auto-fallback to a quantized variant if p95 latency > X. Example rollout snippet:
```
routes:
  - name: zenith-canary
    match: "/chat/*"
    traffic_split:
      - model: redwood-7b-v1
        weight: 90
      - model: redwood-7b-q4-v1
        weight: 10
    fallback_policy:
      latency_p95_ms: 800
      action: route_to_quantized
```

omar_security: For the security questionnaire, two asks to confirm: 1) Will logs with PII leave their VPC? 2) Where are embeddings stored and are they encrypted at rest? We should give a one-page answer for each.

liam_sales-engineer: We can keep KV/cache & inference tenants isolated. Embeddings are stored in our encryption-at-rest storage; offer option for customer to use their KMS for data keys. I’ll draft the one-pagers.

deploybot: Created channel #poc-zenith-private-1835554321 and deployment workspace poc-environment-zenith.

sam_partnerships: Great. Next steps: (1) Liam to send formal quote + lead time by EOD tomorrow; (2) Omar to mark up security questionnaire sections (KMS, network, logs) by EOD day after; (3) Aditya to share SAML SP metadata and runbook snippet; (4) Kai to confirm partner infra contact and preferred meeting slot.

kai_partner-eng: Partner infra contact is m.chen@zenith.io. They asked for a kickoff Wed 9am PT or Thu 11am PT. I prefer Wed.

aditi_solutions: SAML SP metadata: ACS=https://poc-zenith.redwood.ai/saml/acs, EntityID=https://redwood.ai/sp. I’ll upload the short runbook to the channel in 60m.

liam_sales-engineer: Draft quote sent to Sam via email + will post redacted numbers in #poc-zenith-private-1835554321. Planning note: if they ask for lower commitment, we can propose burst-capacity with higher per-token prices as alternative.

omar_security: Starting security Qs now. Will flag anything that requires legal/infosec escalation.

sam_partnerships: Thanks all. If Wed 9am PT works for partner, I’ll lock the calendar and invite product/infrastructure. :thumbsup:

kai_partner-eng: Confirmed Wed 9am PT works for them.

liam_sales-engineer: Added canary + fallback doc link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-fallback. Please review before Wed.

sam_partnerships: Awesome — closing this thread for updates. Post any blockers in the #poc-zenith-private-1835554321 channel. :)
